entries.text: So Koraidon’s an ancient Pokémon...\nNo wonder no one’s seen it before![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_rival_01a

entries.text: So Miraidon’s a future Pokémon...\nNo wonder no one’s seen it before![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_rival_01b

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You’ve gotta let me battle\n[VAR 0x0101(0001)] right now![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_rival_02

entries.text: Um. It still won’t come out of its Poké Ball.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_botan_01

entries.text: That was the first I heard of it coming from the\npast myself...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_01a

entries.text: That was the first I heard of it coming from the\nfuture myself...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_01b

entries.text: It was just some weird Pokémon my mom brought\nhome all of a sudden one day.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_02a

entries.text: It was just some weird Pokémon my dad brought\nhome all of a sudden one day.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_02b

entries.text: We all lived together at the lighthouse lab for\na little while.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_03

entries.text: My [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad made me promise to keep it a secret.\nAnd I had to take care of it for h[VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]erim, too...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_04

entries.text: So that’s why you knew so much about it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_rival_04

entries.text: Yeah, but then one day [VAR 0x0101(0001)] just\nwent nuts against some wild Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_05

entries.text: A few of the folks living nearby ended up\nseeing it, so the secret was out.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_06

entries.text: Once that happened, my mom took it—and went\nback to Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_07a

entries.text: Once that happened, my dad took it—and went\nback to Area Zero.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_07b

entries.text: Guess that makes sense if it’s a Pokémon from a\ndifferent age...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_botan_05

entries.text: Yeah. If people found out, it’d be all over\nthe news.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_08

entries.text: I didn’t see my mom or Koraidon again after that.\nFor ages.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_09a

entries.text: I didn’t see my dad or Miraidon again after that.\nFor ages.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_09b

entries.text: Looking back on it now, it seems stupid, but...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_09

entries.text: I felt like I’d lost my [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad ’cause of [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]KoMiraidon.\nIt was the worst feeling ever.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_10

entries.text: I just hated [VAR 0x0101(0001)] and everything about it.\nDidn’t want to even talk about it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_11

entries.text: I’m sorry for not telling you what I knew\nsooner, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_12

entries.text: You should be sorry! Shoot—that’s, like, the\ncoolest thing ever, and you didn’t tell any of us![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_rival_10

entries.text: Yup. Sure would’ve been great to know all that\nrelevant info before we got here.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_botan_06

entries.text: D-dang, you guys... Harsh...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: atlantis_talk_05_friend_13
